summary: The post-market read is 54.7, caution, with the risk-on regime intact and model confidence at 0.9091 — 3.7 below Tuesday's 58.4 and the second consecutive decline, though 1.35 below the 56.05 the pre-market run published for the same calendar day. The improvement is credit- and volatility-led rather than price-led: HY OAS 3.18 from 3.3, IG OAS 0.88 from 0.9 and VIX 17.52 from 18.39 are all 2026-10-27 prints, so those legs trail today's tape by one session. The session itself was broadly higher — 16 of 22 sectors and themes advanced, memory 6.4946, data centers 3.6818 and AI infrastructure 3.3536 leading, consumer electronics down 2.7944 — and A-shares closed 2026-10-28 with all 11 names up at a mean of 6.3074. The Fed held the target range but two of 12 voters dissented toward a hike, leaving the 10-year at 4.99 and the dollar at 121.3202 as the standing constraint, while breadth at 45.16% above the 200-day average and 1 new high in 156 names remains the weakest link.

top_risk_drivers.claim: The 2.64% real rate and 121.3202 dollar index hold the macro dimension at 74.19, the highest of the six and the single largest structural drag on the score.
HY OAS at 3.18 and IG at 0.88 keep credit the model's top-ranked driver inside liquidity and credit, a dimension still reading 66.37.
Cross-asset confirmation sits at just 0.375 with the dollar-strength and real-rate triggers still on, so the confirmation layer has not cleared.
Breadth is the weakest link: 45.16% of names sit above the 200-day average, only 1 of 156 made a new high, and small caps lag the benchmark by 7.9905 on a 63-session basis.

supporting_signals.claim: Credit improved on the 2026-10-27 prints: HY OAS 3.18 against 3.3 and IG OAS 0.88 against 0.9.
Volatility drops to 30.95 with VIX at 17.52 and realized volatility at 9.9722, the lowest of the six dimensions.
Breadth improved versus 2026-10-27: 45.16% above the 200-day average against 41.94%, and new lows at 2.56% against 6.41%.
The tape was broad: 16 of 22 sectors and themes advanced, led by memory 6.4946, data centers 3.6818 and AI infrastructure 3.3536, with semis at 2.6761.

contradicting_signals.claim: The long end offers no relief: the 10-year is 4.99 on the 2026-10-27 print while the market-implied policy rate sits at 4.035 with the next move priced as a hike.
The consumer and leisure end did not participate: consumer electronics fell 2.7944, gaming 2.0503 and cybersecurity 1.5778 even as the index advanced.
The semiconductors theme printed 2.1289 today but is still 0.6777 behind the benchmark over 63 sessions, so the recovery is recent rather than established.
Part of today's cross-asset relief is mechanical: gold fell 0.0295 and switched its trigger off, while the dollar at 121.3202 and the real rate at 2.64 stayed on.

what_changed_today: The global risk score fell from 58.4 to 54.7 (caution), 3.7 lower on the session and a second consecutive decline.
Cross-asset confirmation was the largest move, 50.0 down to 37.5, as the gold trigger switched off.
Liquidity and credit dropped 5.75 points to 66.37 as the high-yield spread narrowed to 3.18 and IG to 0.88, both 2026-10-27 prints.
Volatility fell 3.35 points to 30.95 as VIX moved from 18.39 to 17.52.
A-shares reversed Tuesday's decline: all 11 names closed higher at a mean of 6.3074, 300223.SZ up 18.3721, against 10 of 11 lower on 2026-10-27.
watch_next: 2026-10-29 brings GDP and Personal Income and Outlays at 12:30Z, the inflation read that decides whether the hawkish hold survives.
Megacap earnings continue on 2026-10-29 with AMZN, INTC, COIN, SBUX, RBLX and RIVN, after Alphabet reported 2.67 EPS against a 2.97 forecast on 2026-10-28.
Whether HY OAS holds at or below 3.18 and VIX below 17.52 — the two legs behind today's improvement have to confirm rather than revert.
If the dollar index pushes past 121.3202, or the real rate past 2.64 under a hawkish Fed, cross-asset confirmation at 0.375 retraces toward 50.0.
Before the risk-on regime can be called durable, breadth has to clear 50% above the 200-day average and lift new highs above 1 in 156 names.

bull_case.title: Bull case: the credit-led improvement extends
points: If HY OAS stays at or below 3.18 and VIX below 17.52, the two legs that took the score to 54.7 keep working and the cross-asset reading of 0.375 holds.
Memory at 6.4946 and data centers at 3.6818 carry into the 2026-10-29 megacap results and hold the tape's 16 of 22 breadth.

base_case.title: Base case: the caution band holds near 54.7
points: The score oscillates between 54.7 and 58.4, with macro at 74.19 capping the downside and breadth at 45.16% capping the upside.
Credit and volatility keep improving on a one-session lag, so each post-market print inherits the prior session's direction.

bear_case.title: Bear case: a hawkish hold meets a strong dollar
points: If the 10-year moves back above 4.99 and the dollar index above 121.3202, the cross-asset leg adds triggers and the score returns above 58.4.
Breadth at 45.16% with only 1 new high in 156 names leaves little cushion if memory at 6.4946 mean-reverts.
